children: Six people were killed and one person was injured when a train collided with a minibus in Russia's Far Eastern Jewish Autonomous Region, the state RIA news agency reported, citing local railway authorities.
The minibus was crossing the tracks at a level crossing when it was struck by the train, the report said.
